reviewed_evidence_plan.active_setup: Construct each fixed road layout with documented one-way designation and an actual direction sign governing ego. Use ordinary motor vehicles and supported routes. Include travel in both physical directions in separate runs, retaining the designated direction and any reversing motion without assigning legal outcomes.
reviewed_evidence_plan.comparison_or_sweep: Compare actual travel vectors and displacement with the designated direction, preserving raw geometry without an invented angular cutoff. Evaluate the training demo on C150916 with both designation and signposting present; an unsigned map attribute is insufficient.
